## Activity

River Outreach recorded 54 captures during February 2024. Capture activity was documented for the reporting period, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The available activity record provides the basis for review of image quality and grading outcomes.

## Image quality

There were 7 ungradable captures. The ungradable rate was 13.0 per cent. This result is noted for monitoring alongside overall capture activity and provides a summary of the proportion of images that could not be assessed. No further image-quality issues are identified in the report.

## Grading

There were 2 referable results. The median grading lag was 0. This indicates that the reported grading activity was completed without a median delay during the period under review. The referable results and image-quality outcome should be considered together when reviewing the service’s performance for February 2024. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave, and no operational variance beyond this was recorded.
